spiflash.description: Divisor of the MMAP commands, sent with each transfer. 0: use `phy_clk_divisor`.
spiflash.name: mmap_clk_divisor

spiflash.description: Dummy phase of the MMAP read command, in bits at the address width (dummy cycles x address lines). The reset value is `dummy_cycles` x `addr_width` of the module for a fast read, else 0. Present with `with_csr=True` (default).
spiflash.name: mmap_dummy_bits

spiflash.description: Bit 0 `write_enable`: 1 sends the Wishbone writes to the chip as page programs (`program_cmd` of the module), 0 acknowledges and drops them. The MMAP sends no write enable (WREN) itself. Present with `with_mmap_write="csr"`.
spiflash.name: mmap_write_config

spiflash.description: Chip select of the master, one bit per CS line: 1 selects the chip (CS low) and holds the PHY through the crossbar, 0 ends the command.
spiflash.name: master_cs

fields.description: SPI DQ output enable mask (set bits to ``1`` to enable output drivers on DQ lines).
fields.name: mask

spiflash.description: Write: push one transfer of `phyconfig.len` bits, right aligned, to the TX FIFO. Read: pop the 32-bit word shifted in during one transfer from the RX FIFO.
spiflash.name: master_rxtx

fields.description: TX FIFO is not full. Write rxtx only when set: a write to a full TX FIFO is dropped.
fields.name: tx_ready

spiflash.description: Divisor of the master transfers, sent with each transfer. 0: use `phy_clk_divisor`.
spiflash.name: master_clk_divisor

spiflash.description: This register contains the current raw level of the event trigger. Writes to this register have no effect.
spiflash.name: master_ev_status

spiflash.description: When an event occurs, the corresponding bit will be set in this register. To clear the Event, set the corresponding bit in this register.

fields.description: `1` if a `rx_ready` event occurred. This Event is triggered on **rising** edge.
fields.name: rx_ready

spiflash.name: master_ev_pending

spiflash.description: This register enables the corresponding events. Write a ``0`` to this register to disable individual events.

fields.description: Write a ``1`` to enable the ``rx_ready`` Event.
fields.name: rx_ready

spiflash.name: master_ev_enable
